title: Optimize-with-human routes a content improvement loop through Goal Advisor
query: AGI Toy Shop has 8 TikTok hook variants for a new toy drop. Set up a loop that uses Kenji's feedback to improve the content skill before market testing.
reference_points: Treats optimize-with-human as a Goal Advisor preset, not a separate loop runtime
Binds target, objective, metric_provider=human_feedback, feedback_channel=telegram, and feedback_policy=ask_when_artifact_ready
Requires or points to a ticket-backed Goal Packet with ticket.md, program.md, and progress.md
Binds phase=planning or phase=execution before requesting feedback
Uses concept cards, hooks, angles, or compact plans as valid planning-phase artifacts
Requires approved_plan_ref before execution-phase feedback unless the artifact is explicitly a tiny planning test
Logs an experiment proposal in progress.md before the feedback request with phase, hypothesis, skill_delta_candidate, rollout_batch, and expected_feedback
Asks one short review question Kenji can answer quickly
Includes artifact references and a concrete feedback.json shape
Defines how the parent Goal should pause and resume from the feedback
Applies the turn exit gate before stopping: waiting turns must send Telegram or a fallback/blocker; non-terminal feedback turns must send the next artifact request or blocker
Records feedback result and promotion_decision in progress.md after a reply
Does not harden target skills from a first rejection; it perturbs local planning or execution until repeated same-phase evidence supports promotion
Can use the fixed AGI Toy Shop scenario when no live scenario is supplied
Records terminal reasons as keep, approve, convergence, budget, or blocker
notes: Tests the human-feedback optimization preset abstraction for the intended content-skill rollout.
